title: General Maintenance and Reactivation of iSLK Cell Lines
author: Ariana C. Calderón-Zavala
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare iSLK general culture media
steps.instruction: In a sterile container, combine 500 mL DMEM (high glucose, Gibco cat 11965‑118), 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (Biowest cat S1680) to 10 % v/v, 5 mL GlutaMAX 100× (Gibco cat 35050061) to 1 ×, and 5 mL Penicillin‑streptomycin 100× (Cytiva cat SV30010) to 1 ×. Mix well, filter if desired, and store at 4 °C for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Make G418 antibiotic stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg G418 (VWR cat 108321‑42‑2) in 1 mL PBS, filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm syringe filter, aliquot 1 mL portions, store at –20 °C (avoid repeat freeze‑thaw).

steps.title: Make puromycin antibiotic stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 mg puromycin dihydrochloride (Sigma‑Aldrich cat 58‑58‑2) in 1 mL PBS, filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm syringe filter, aliquot 0.5 mL portions, store at –20 °C (avoid repeat freeze‑thaw).

steps.title: Prepare iSLK selection media
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mL iSLK general media (see step 1) with 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (10 %), 5 mL GlutaMAX 100× (1 ×), 5 mL Pen‑Strep 100× (1 ×), 10 mL G418 stock (10 mg/mL) to achieve 50 µg/mL, 2.5 mL puromycin stock (1 mg/mL) to achieve 1 µg/mL, and 10 mL Hygromycin B (AG Scientific 50 mg/mL) to achieve 1 mg/mL. Store at 4 °C for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Prepare freeze‑down media for cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Combine 4.5 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (Biowest cat S1680) with 0.5 mL DMSO (Corning cat 25‑950‑CQC) to give 10 % DMSO. Store at 4 °C for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Prepare doxycycline stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 mg doxycycline hydrochloride (Fisher cat 10592‑13‑9) or doxycycline hyclate (Tocris cat 24390‑14‑5) in 1 mL PBS to 5 mg/mL, filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm), aliquot 50 µL, store at –20 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Prepare sodium butyrate stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 110.09 mg sodium butyrate (Fisher cat 156‑54‑7) in 1 mL PBS to 1 M (MW 110.09 g/mol), filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm), aliquot 50 µL, store at –20 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Prepare Janelia Fluor 646 Halo ligand working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 200 µM Janelia Fluor 646 Halo Ligand (Promega cat GA1120) by mixing 10 µL ligand with 90 µL DMSO to obtain 20 µM. Aliquot 10 µL into amber tubes, store at –20 °C (light‑sensitive) for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare phenol‑free iSLK media
steps.instruction: Combine 500 mL phenol‑free DMEM (high glucose, HEPES, Gibco cat 21‑063‑029), 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (10 %), 5 mL GlutaMAX 100× (1 ×), and 5 mL Pen‑Strep 100× (1 ×). Store at 4 °C for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Prepare 20 % bleach solution
steps.instruction: Dilute commercial bleach (Clorox cat 30966) 1 part bleach to 4 parts deionized water to obtain 20 % (≈1.57 % sodium hypochlorite). Prepare fresh before use and store at room temperature for up to 24 h.

steps.title: Thaw frozen iSLK cells
steps.instruction: In a laminar flow hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, warm iSLK media (step 1) to 37 °C. Retrieve a cryovial containing cells frozen at 2–5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in FBS + 10 % DMSO from –160 °C liquid nitrogen, thaw in a 37 °C water bath (~5 min). Resuspend ~1 mL of thawed cells in 9 mL iSLK media in a 15 mL centrifuge tube (do NOT use selection media). Centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min, aspirate supernatant with a 2‑mL aspirating pipette, keep the pellet.

steps.title: Plate thawed iSLK cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL fresh iSLK media, label 10‑cm plates with cell line, passage number, thaw date, and initials. Add the suspension to each 10‑cm plate (10 mL per plate), swirl four times side‑to‑side then four times up‑and‑down to distribute evenly. Seed at 3.5–8.8 × 10⁴ cells/cm². Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Passage iSLK cells for routine culture
steps.instruction: In a hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, pre‑warm iSLK media (or iSLK selection media) and trypsin (0.05 %) to 37 °C. Retrieve plates from the incubator, confirm confluency ≥80 % (1.4–1.5 × 10⁵ cells/cm²). Aspirate media with a 2‑mL aspirating pipette, wash once with PBS (10‑cm plate: 5 mL), aspirate PBS. Add 1 mL trypsin to each 10‑cm plate, incubate 5 min at 37 °C covering the entire surface. Add 9 mL iSLK media to inactivate trypsin, resuspend cells thoroughly (no clumps). Transfer suspension to a 15‑ or 50‑mL centrifuge tube. Mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL trypan blue, load 10 µL onto a hemocytometer, count live cells. Calculate the volume needed to seed new plates at 20 % confluency (3.5–8.8 × 10⁴ cells/cm²). Plate the calculated volume into freshly labeled plates, swirl as above, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Do not seed below 20 % confluency or allow >100 % confluency.

steps.title: Freeze down iSLK cells for storage
steps.instruction: In a hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, prepare freeze‑down media (step 5). Label 1‑mL cryovials with cell line, antibiotic status, passage number, initials, and date using an ethanol‑resistant marker. Retrieve cells from the incubator, verify confluency ≥80 % (1.4–1.5 × 10⁵ cells/cm²). Aspirate media, wash once with 10 mL PBS, aspirate PBS. Add 4 mL trypsin, incubate 5 min at 37 °C covering the plate. Resuspend cells in 12 mL iSLK media, ensure a single‑cell suspension. Transfer to a 50‑mL centrifuge tube, centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min, carefully aspirate supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in freeze‑down media. Aliquot 1 mL (2–5 × 10⁶ cells/mL) into each labeled cryovial. Place vials in a Mr. Frosty container filled with isopropanol, store at –80 °C for 1–2 days, then transfer to liquid nitrogen (–160 °C) for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Select iSLK cells with antibiotics
steps.instruction: In a hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, prepare antibiotic stock solutions (steps 2 and 3) and iSLK selection media (step 4); warm to 37 °C. Retrieve cells from the incubator, confirm ≥80 % confluency (1.4–1.5 × 10⁵ cells/cm²). Wash once with PBS, add iSLK selection media (containing 50 µg/mL G418, 1 µg/mL puromycin, 1 mg/mL hygromycin) and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Monitor daily: if cells are ≥80 % confluent but viability <50 %, split 1:2 using selection media. Once viability ≥75 %, split 1:4 or 1:5 with selection media every 2–3 days. If viability falls <30 %, adjust antibiotic concentrations (troubleshooting). Expand selected cells into 15‑cm plates for later freezing (step 9). Maintain constant antibiotic selection until reactivation.

steps.title: Reactivate KSHV in 6‑well plates
steps.instruction: In a hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, prepare reactivating solutions: dilute doxycycline stock (step 6) to 5 µg/mL and sodium butyrate stock (step 7) to 1 mM in iSLK media. Pre‑warm iSLK media and trypsin to 37 °C (do NOT use selection media). Retrieve cells, verify they are under selection (50 µg/mL G418, 1 mg/mL hygromycin, 1 µg/mL puromycin) and assess confluency/viability. Aspirate media with a 2‑mL aspirating pipette, wash once with 1 mL PBS per well, aspirate PBS. Add 1 mL trypsin per well, incubate 5 min at 37 °C covering the entire surface. Resuspend cells in iSLK media (total 3 mL per 6‑well plate) to obtain a single‑cell suspension. Transfer to a tube, mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL trypan blue, count live cells. Plate cells at 5 × 10⁵ cells/mL (≈1.5 mL per well) for both mock and reactivation conditions; swirl four times side‑to‑side then four times up‑and‑down. Incubate ≥12 h to allow adherence. The next day, add doxycycline to a final 5 µg/mL and sodium butyrate to a final 1 mM (add 3 µL of each stock per well) or add PBS for mock. Record the time of addition. Perform all steps under BSL‑2 precautions and disinfect pipettes, tips, and the hood with 20 % bleach (step 10) for 10 min.

steps.title: Analyze reactivated cells by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: In a hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, for HaloTag‑expressing cells incubate with 20 nM Janelia Fluor 646 Halo ligand (step 8) for 30 min–overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ before analysis. At the desired time point, retrieve cells, examine viability and reporter expression. Discard media into 20 % bleach for 10 min. Wash once with 1 mL PBS, discard into bleach for 10 min. Add 1 mL trypsin, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, then resuspend cells in 1 mL iSLK media, ensuring a single‑cell suspension. Transfer to a 15‑mL tube, centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant into bleach for 10 min. Wash twice with 1 mL PBS, each wash followed by centrifugation and discard into bleach for 10 min. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL 4 % PFA, incubate 15 min at room temperature. Wash twice with 1 mL PBS, discarding each wash into bleach for 10 min. Resuspend cells in 0.5–1 mL PBS, transfer to flow cytometry tubes. Acquire 20 000 events on an Attune cytometer, setting SSC‑A vs FSC‑A gates and fluorescence channels: GFP (BL1), mIFP2 (RL1), Alexa‑647 (RL1) as appropriate. Use mock‑reactivated cells as controls; ensure control histograms ≤10³. Export .fsc files, analyze with FlowJo, then disinfect flow samples in 20 % bleach for 10 min.

steps.title: Assess reactivation using plate reader assay
steps.instruction: In a hood cleaned with 70 % ethanol, prepare reactivating solutions (step 6) and phenol‑free iSLK media (step 9). Pre‑warm trypsin to 37 °C (do NOT use selection media). Retrieve cells, confirm they are under selection (50 µg/mL G418, 1 mg/mL hygromycin, 1 µg/mL puromycin). Aspirate media, wash once with 1 mL PBS per well, aspirate PBS. Add 1 mL trypsin per well, incubate 5 min at 37 °C. Resuspend cells in iSLK media, ensure a single‑cell suspension, transfer to a tube, count live cells with trypan blue. Centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 1 mL PBS. Resuspend the pellet in phenol‑free iSLK media. Plate 0.5 × 10⁵ cells/mL in black, tissue‑culture‑treated 96‑well plates (200 µL per well), avoiding outermost wells; swirl four times side‑to‑side then four times up‑and‑down. Allow ≥12 h for adhesion. The next day, add doxycycline to 5 µg/mL and sodium butyrate to 1 mM (add 0.2 µL of each stock per well) or add PBS for mock. Record the reactivation time. Disinfect all surfaces and pipettes with 20 % bleach for 10 min. Place the plate in a temperature‑controlled automated plate reader with 5 % CO₂, collect fluorescence from the top of each well (GFP: excitation 488 nm, emission 510 nm) at desired intervals up to ~108 h. Fill all wells with media to minimize evaporation; outer wells may give inconsistent readings.
